title: Adding GIFs to Emails
html:
GIFs can make your emails more engaging by adding motion to images and video thumbnails. You can add GIFs to emails through the email editor using files stored in the Media Library. This article explains how to add a GIF as an image or use one as a video thumbnail.

TABLE OF CONTENTS

  • What Are GIFs in Emails?
  • How to Add GIFs to Emails
  • Frequently Asked Questions
  • Related Articles

What Are GIFs in Emails?


GIFs are animated image files that can add movement and visual interest to your emails. In the Email Builder, GIFs can be inserted as images or used as custom thumbnails for Video elements.


GIF files used in the Email Builder can be selected from or uploaded to the Media Library.

How to Add GIFs to Emails


Using GIFs in the Design Editor lets you add animated visuals without changing your normal email-building workflow. You can insert a GIF directly through an Image element or use one as the thumbnail for a Video element.


Note: GIF uploads used in the Email Builder should not exceed 10 MB.



Add a GIF as an Image


  1. Go to Marketing > Emails.

  2. Create a newemail or open an existing email or template.



  3. Open the email in the Editor.

  4. From the Elements panel, drag an Image element into your email.

  5. Click the Image element.

  6. Click the edit/pencil icon for the image.

  7. Select the option to upload or choose media from the Media Library.

  8. Select an existing GIF or upload a new GIF.

  9. Click Insert Media to add the GIF to your email.

  10. Save your changes and preview the email before sending.



Use a GIF as a Video Thumbnail


  1. From the Elements panel, drag a Video element into your email.

  2. Click the Video element.

  3. Locate the video thumbnail and click the edit/pencil icon.

  4. Open the Media Library.

  5. Select an existing GIF or upload a new GIF.

  6. Click Insert Media to apply the GIF as the video thumbnail.

  7. Save your changes and preview the email.

Frequently Asked Questions


Q: Where do I upload GIFs for use in an email?
GIFs can be uploaded to and selected from the Media Library while editing an Image or Video element.

Q: Can I use a GIF as a video thumbnail?
Yes. You can select a GIF from the Media Library and apply it as the custom thumbnail for a Video element.

Q: What is the maximum GIF file size?
GIF files used in the Email Builder should not exceed 10 MB.

Q: Should I preview my email after adding a GIF?
Yes. Previewing the email helps you confirm that the GIF and other email content appear as expected before sending.

Q: Can I reuse a GIF that is already in the Media Library?
Yes. You can select an existing GIF from the Media Library without uploading it again.
